label: Web app — Next.js + shadcn/ui
summary: A website or web app you can open in the browser right away: pages, a ready-made set of buttons and forms, and one command to run it.
fits: most new products — a landing page, a dashboard, an online tool, a store front.

requires.why: Node.js runs the app; install it from https://nodejs.org (version 20.9 or newer)
pnpm downloads the app's packages; install it with: npm install -g pnpm

steps.label: Create the Next.js app
steps.note: Every choice is passed as a flag so a saved create-next-app preference cannot change the result. --disable-git: cckit init makes the repository and the first commit. --no-agents-md: the agent instruction files are the ones cckit writes. --no-agent-feedback: nothing is prepared for sending to a third party without the user asking.

steps.label: Add shadcn/ui (design system) with its default look
steps.note: --defaults is `--template=next --preset=base-nova` in shadcn 4.23.0. It writes components.json, lib/utils.ts, the theme variables in app/globals.css and components/ui/button.tsx.

steps.label: Add the basic components: card, input, label
steps.run: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add card input label --yes

drifts: the component names passed to `shadcn add`
